---
title: Reward decomposition
---

What each reward component paid per training episode, weight times its logged total, averaged over every episode of an arm's seeds in each 500,000-step window. Penalties stack below zero, and the black mark is the mean episode return the bars sum to. The baseline is E3's count arm. RND is not shown: its reward is not in the Parquet logs.

```{python}
#| output: asis
from pathlib import Path

from algoarcade.viz.decomposition import figure
from algoarcade.viz.e3_e5 import COUNT, E5
from algoarcade.viz.site import connect, show

show(figure(connect(), {"baseline": COUNT, **E5}))
```

## Clips

Each clip under `data/videos/hacks/`, named by its exploit in the catalogue below.

```{python}
#| output: asis
clips = sorted(Path("videos/hacks").glob("*.mp4"))
for clip in clips:
    print(f'```{{=html}}\n<p>{clip.stem}</p>\n<video controls src="{clip.as_posix()}" data-external="1"></video>\n```')
if not clips:
    print("No clip yet.")
```
